note: Main camping area on a peninsula on the east shore of 240-acre Pony Express Lake, off Route RA and Lakesite Road by the paved boat ramp: a large gravel lot with a privy and, beside it, a mown lawn with scattered shade trees that slopes down to a cove 50-70 m off. No pads; rigs use the lot and its edge. A second designated camping area is the field-trial grounds on Maple Road, about a mile west on the other side of the lake: a gravel drive, a building and a mown field dotted with trees, with no lake in sight. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Designated Camping Sites' - two camping areas on the map and in GIS, the main one on the east-shore peninsula by the ramp (where the pin is) and one at the Maple Road field-trial grounds 1.5 km west. Free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. Stored lakeview fits the main area. Pin and phone fine.
flags: INCLUSION (stays): the area page lists 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites'; the brochure says 'Camping is permitted only in primitive camping designated areas and is limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30 day period' and 'Fires are permitted only in designated camping areas', and mentions waste containers at the camping areas. The map (11/12) draws Primitive Camping Area symbols in two places: on the east-shore peninsula beside two Parking Lot symbols, privies and the Paved Boat Ramp, and on Maple Rd beside a Parking Lot, a Privy and the Multi-Use Facility symbol. GIS layer 27 has two points (OBJECTIDs 308 east, 109 west). EAST, on the 380 m frame: a gravel lot about 75 x 35 m beside the paved loop to the ramp, and south-west of it a mown lawn about 110 x 50 m with scattered trees running down to a cove; the GIS point is on that lawn. It is a camping lawn of its own beside the lot, not just the ramp lot. WEST, on the 300 m frame: a gravel drive off Maple Rd to a metal building with a privy-sized structure and a gravel turnaround, and south of the building a mown field about 150 x 100 m dotted with trees and criss-crossed by vehicle tracks; the GIS point is in that field. A 23-ft rig fits either.

CLUSTERS / MAIN CAMP: the east-shore peninsula is the main camp (the ramp, two privies, the big lot, the lake) and the stored pin 39.80009,-94.37944 is on its camping lawn - no move. The Maple Road camp is the field-trial grounds (the brochure: 'Horseback riding is permitted only in conjunction with the field trial events when authorized'; the page lists 'Field Trials - Special Use Permit'); MDC does not label either a horse camp.

SPLIT (possible, owner's call): the two camping areas are 1,513 m apart (GIS points) and on opposite sides of the lake with separate entrances - the east one off Route RA / Lakesite Rd, the west one its own drive off Maple Rd (39.79697,-94.39666; lot 7816 at 39.79746,-94.39642). The west one is more than a single small lot (a field of roughly 150 x 100 m). No existing entry lies within 4 km of it other than this one. It would be 'not waterfront' (Pony Express Lake's west arm is about 300 m north across fields by the map; no water in view on the frame apart from a small pond 150 m south).

WATERFRONT (stored lakeview - stands): at the main area the camping lawn is open grass with a few trees, 50-70 m from the cove shore to its south-west, and the gravel lot is about 95 m from that shore; north of the lot the paved ramp loop lies between the lot and the main lake. Open and in view but not within a site-depth of the water from where a rig stands, and the loop road blocks the north side: lakeview, as stored.

ACCESS: 'From Cameron, take Highway 36 west 6 miles, then Highway 33 north 2 miles, then Route RA 1.50 miles to area entrance.' The map shows paved road to the east-shore lot and ramp; Maple Rd is gravel. No ford, 4WD wording or posted limit.
PHONE: stored 816-381-8458 matches the area page ('For more information call (816) 381-8458').
